title: Winner Takes All, 500 CFA francs

specs.Decoration: digital printing, laser frosting, microprinting, selective gilding

descriptionPlain: Description A manifesto of strength, ambition, and success, created for leaders and visionaries of the financial world. At its heart lies a powerful, gilded bull – an undisputed symbol of a stock market bull run, which embodies growth, strength, and courage in decision-making. The background, filled with stock charts and currency symbols, captures the pulse of contemporary markets. This is a coin for those who are not afraid of risk and know that in the highest-stakes game, the winner takes all.
